notes.title: Mono is getting some upgrades and fixes!
notes.content:
Hello! We’ve been working hard to gather feedback and continually improve the game. The community has shared tons of ideas on improvements and places that could use additional focus.

We’ve heard players loud and clear on improvements and have been working on improving certain mechanics and gameplay features.

[list]
[*] Mid-air movement - we’ve broken away from the realistic physics to more of the enjoyable physics players typically find in various games. We’ve given players the ability to control Mono slightly mid-air where he can now turn and move in the selected direction more fluidly.
[*] Arm skill responsiveness - The magnetic arm and the swapping arm skills have gotten an upgrade! Some players felt as the skills weren’t as snappy as they’d like so we’ve tuned them a bit further. Arm skills now respond much more quickly to use and then go into their cool down.
[*] Cranks - Some players were experiencing difficulties with cranks in area 1. We’ve since tuned it a bit to lessen difficulties in crank-related challenges.
[*] And many other smaller bug fixes around save points, respawn, and other smaller features. Feel free to look at the hot fix/patch notes over the last week for more details.
[/list]

Thanks again for everyone that has opened a dialogue up with the team to make the world of Monobot even better. We couldn’t have done this without you. Cheers!

The Ukuza and DreamSmith teams

notes.title: One week post-launch updates + giveaway!
notes.content:
Here we are. One week since launch already! What a crazy ride. Our teams cannot express how awesome the community has been with embracing Mono and his desolate world. We've seen some amazing playthroughs where people have laughed, smashed controllers, and gushed over Mono as a cute little robot. We can't thank the community enough! If you haven't yet grabbed a copy of Monobot, the Steam launch week discount ends tomorrow. So grab a copy before it goes back up in price!

You all have been instrumental in making the game better. From the initial launch and identifying bugs or even just play balancing to improve areas that were too challenging or even too easy. The DreamSmith Studio team has been heads down smashing bugs and pushing updates live on Steam for everyone.  They've done an absolutely fantastic job maintaining the build so huge shoutout to them!

Check out this hilarious bug found by ClassicCaleb

https://clips.twitch.tv/WittyInnocentAlfalfaGivePLZ-_jpkC3Kt81HxHnGv?tt_content=url&tt_medium=clips_api

If you haven't yet left a review, please leave a review to help others in the Steam community find Monobot. Steam recommends titles that have recent reviews that are a good match and shares with other players. So please leave a quick review and help us spread the good word of Monobot!

Check out some of the amazing streamers who have played Monobot:

CyborgAngel - https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1059973783?t=03h25m02s
Farfromsubtle - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=duHvPG2Cu8s
BlueandQueenie - https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1060020251?t=03h38m46s
Lolirot - https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1060490114?t=00h22m39s

We've gotten some fantastic coverage globally for Monobot:

PCGamesN - https://www.pcgamesn.com/june-games-2021
Thumb Culture - https://www.thumbculture.co.uk/monobot-review
Eurogamer - https://www.eurogamer.de/articles/2021-06-18-fuehrt-ab-heute-einen-niedlichen-roboter-in-monobot-durch-eine-dunkle-feindselige-zukunftswelt
GameSpark - https://www.gamespark.jp/article/2021/06/24/109870.html


Giveaway announcement!!! ːsteamhappyː

Ukuza will be doing a giveaway starting later today on Twitter ( https://twitter.com/Ukuza_games ) for some tasty Monobot swag packs and game keys. Details on the giveaway will be tweeted out so be sure to follow and turn on notifications. Everyone loves gear, go we are giving away some to our community. Stay tuned for details shortly!!!

Thanks again for the amazing support on Monobot and we can't wait to share more with you shortly!

notes.title: Monobot is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The time has come and Monobot is now available for purchase on Steam with a special launch discount! The discount is only available this week, so be sure to grab a copy while it lasts! ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212850

Our little bot is coming off the factory shelf and being thrust into a dark, hostile, and challenge world absent of humanity. Avoid hostile robots utilizing stealth and solve challenging puzzles to uncover what happened to humanity.

Join us today and celebrate the release of Monobot by picking up a copy, playing it on Steam, and sharing Mono's world with the community!

We're insanely happy to have you on the journey with us and we're excited for you to play Monobot! Tag us on Twitter @ukuza_games if you stream or create content, and we'll share them with the community! Cheers!

The Ukuza and DreamSmith Studio Teams

notes.content: Join us now as we dip into the beginning of Monobot and share some of the full gameplay. Ukuza will be sharing the introduction to the game as we approach launch on Friday. Join us for a glimpse!

notes.title: Monobot Launches on Friday!
notes.content:
The launch of Monobot is only 3 days away!

We're prepping all systems and getting ready for zero hour for Mono to boot up. Our team is excited to share Mono's world and story with you all. It will be a dark and challenging journey but we are sure you're up for the task. Just be sure to avoid the MOWOBOTs and their advanced weaponry.

The dev team put together a small Imgur post on their journey building the first prototypes of Monobot and how they formed DreamSmith Studio. Be sure to check it out below and give it an upvote for support!

[url=https://imgur.com/gallery/iKcAGiz]Designing 'Monobot', a dark sci-fi puzzle platformer game inspired by Limbo and Wall-e[/url]

Thank you all again for the amazing support of our team and we can't wait for you to play Monobot on Friday!

The Ukuza and DreamSmith Studio teams

notes.title: Monobot Launch Trailer & Release Date
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that Monobot is officially launching on Steam on [b]June 18, 2021[/b]!

Today we revealed the Monobot launch trailer, which can be seen now on the store page and below, showcasing more parts of the game and digging deeper into Monobot's story. It focuses on Mono's journey and the dangers faced in this world. Can you help him break the cycle?

With us being two weeks away from launch, we couldn't be more excited to share the story of this little bot in a hostile world. We'd love your help to share Monobot with the world! "How can I help" you ask?

[list]
[*] Add Monobot to your Steam Wishlist. ːsteamthumbsupː
[*]Follow Ukuza on [url=https://twitter.com/Ukuza_games/status/1399728844504961026]Twitter[/url]  and comment, like, and share some of the really awesome screenshots, video clips, and concept art we've been sharing
[*]Head over to [url=https://youtu.be/iwILKnnAexs]YouTube[/url] and give the new trailer a thumbs up and a comment
[/list]

The DreamSmith Studio team has lots of surprises in-store for you with puzzles, enemies, and stories in this desolate world of Monobot! We're excited to share it with you. 

Once again, thank you for supporting Monobot on this wild ride!

The Ukuza Team
